traits.name: Ace
traits.rules: Once per round, reroll one attack die roll or a Fault roll.

traits.name: Gunner
traits.rules: The first weapon fired each activation costs 1 less Pressure (minimum 0).

traits.name: Brawler
traits.rules: +1 damage on melee weapon hits and Ram hits.

traits.name: Tactician
traits.rules: Once per Trial, after this war-walker activates, activate it again immediately.

traits.name: Iron Nerve
traits.rules: Faults are rolled from 1 more Overpressure than normal.
